description: Paint the input Space with a colour fill or diagonal/dots hatch (passes the space through).
instructions:
A pure styling node — takes a Space, passes its geometry straight through (so the pipeline continues), and paints a coloured fill / hatch over it in the live preview. With `hatch` off it's a flat `color` fill at `opacity`; with hatch on, a diagonal-line or random-dot pattern (spacing / angle / weight controls). Mirrors the Display block's hatch styling.

TIP: use it to colour-code Spaces (zoning studies) without altering geometry.
